chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Ibn Bukayr, from a man who said:
I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'The man comes to his mahram.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'He is struck with one strike of the sword.'

key_terms.ذَاتَ مَحْرَمٍ: A close female relative with whom marriage is permanently forbidden

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for a man who commits adultery with his close relative (mahram) according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) prescribes execution by the sword for a man committing adultery with a *mahram* female relative, highlighting the severity of violating kinship ties (*silat al-rahim*). This ruling reflects the Shia jurisprudential view that incestuous relations with close relatives carry a distinct and severe penalty, often interpreted as *hadd* execution, due to the unique sanctity of the familial bond. The brevity of the report underscores the direct authority of the Imam in defining this specific legal consequence without need for extensive elaboration.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Ibn Bukeyr, from a man who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘The man comes to his Mahram’. Heasws said: ‘He would be struck with one strike of the sword’.
